company.name: Pixelhive Studio
company.summary: Pixelhive Studio is a Berlin creative and digital marketing agency with 18 people. You and your team run social campaigns, create ads, produce design and copy, report monthly results to clients, and manage many revision rounds.
offerings: Social media campaign strategy and management
Digital ad creation for Meta, Google and similar platforms
Landing page and small website development
company.customers: Small and mid-sized brands, consumer companies and local businesses that need ongoing marketing creative and campaign support. Likely B2C clients plus some B2B clients in Berlin, Germany and nearby markets.
tech_signals: Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager

roles.title: Graphic Designer
repetitive_tasks: Resizing ad creative for multiple placements

roles.title: Copywriter
repetitive_tasks: Writing social captions and ad copy variants

roles.title: Campaign Manager
repetitive_tasks: Setting up ad campaigns in Meta and Google
Coordinating campaign assets with design and copy

roles.title: Account Coordinator
repetitive_tasks: Preparing simple client reports and invoices

roles.title: Web Developer
repetitive_tasks: Running small site edits and QA

roles.title: Operations Manager
repetitive_tasks: Keeping internal processes and templates updated

strategy.situation: Pixelhive Studio is an 18-person Berlin agency running social campaigns, ad creative, copy, and monthly reporting for many clients. Most work moves through Slack, Asana or Trello, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and platform ad tools.
strategy.complication: Your team repeats the same setup, scheduling, metric pulling, feedback chasing, and file prep across every client, so deadlines slip when volume rises. Client reporting and campaign checks depend on busy people remembering manual steps, which creates errors and slow responses.
strategy.governing_thought: Start with three agents for social scheduling and comment triage, monthly client reporting, and campaign setup QA to reduce missed messages, produce cleaner reports, and speed campaign launches.

key_arguments.headline: Social, account, and creative teams carry most repeated client work
key_arguments.support: Social managers and community managers repeat scheduling, comment checks, and metric pulls for every client. Account teams chase feedback, build monthly reports, and track revision rounds by hand. Creative teams spend hours resizing, exporting, and renaming files after each approval.

key_arguments.headline: The first three agents target frequent, low-risk work with clear inputs
key_arguments.support: Social scheduling and comment triage use tools you already have and affect every client account. Monthly reporting pulls from known platforms into a template your account team already owns. Campaign setup QA catches costly mistakes before spend starts. These three show proof quickly without touching sensitive creative decisions.

key_arguments.headline: Pilot each agent with one owner, human approval, and weekly checks
key_arguments.support: Run a four-week pilot per agent with one process owner and human approval on client-facing output. Review errors and time saved weekly, then scale to all clients once the workflow is stable. Keep manual fallbacks for platform access issues and unclear briefs.

strategy.executive_summary: Pixelhive Studio is an 18-person Berlin agency running social campaigns, ad creative, copy, and monthly reporting for many clients. Most work moves through Slack, Asana or Trello, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and platform ad tools. Your team repeats the same setup, scheduling, metric pulling, feedback chasing, and file prep across every client, so deadlines slip when volume rises. maturity.label: Early
maturity.note: AI use is ad hoc, mostly writing help and simple automations, and no agent owns a recurring workflow yet.

opportunities.title: Social posts scheduled and routine comments triaged
opportunities.description: An agent schedules approved posts across client accounts and drafts replies to routine comments for human review. It flags urgent or negative messages in Slack with context.

Upload and schedule posts one by one
Check comments and messages across platforms
Copy engagement numbers into a sheet
after: Agent pulls approved assets from Asana and Google Drive
Agent schedules posts in Hootsuite, Later, and Meta Business Suite
Agent drafts routine comment replies and flags urgent ones in Slack
Human: reviews and approves replies and schedule changes
Agent logs engagement numbers for reporting

opportunities.title: Monthly client reports built from live metrics
opportunities.description: An agent pulls metrics from Meta, Google Ads, and GA4 into a client-ready draft with commentary prompts. It updates the same report template each month.
before: Log into each ad and analytics platform
Ask account lead to check and send
after: Agent connects to Meta Ads, Google Ads, and GA4
Agent fills the monthly report template
Agent drafts commentary based on changes
Human: checks numbers, edits narrative, and approves
Agent saves final PDF and updates client tracker

opportunities.title: Ad campaigns checked before launch and pacing alerts sent daily
opportunities.description: An agent runs a pre-launch checklist on new Meta and Google campaigns and posts daily pacing alerts. It catches missing pixels, wrong budgets, and broken links before spend starts.

Manually check budgets, audiences, and tracking
Ask designer for missing asset sizes
after: Agent reads campaign setup from Meta and Google
Agent checks budget, audience, pixels, links, and asset sizes
Agent posts a Slack checklist with failed items
Human: fixes flagged items and approves launch
Agent sends daily pacing alerts with budget burn

opportunities.title: Ad creative resized and exported for every placement
opportunities.description: An agent prepares common ad sizes from approved Figma or Photoshop files and names files to your convention. Designers review and adjust only where the layout breaks.
before: Rename and upload to shared drive
after: Agent reads approved master file
Agent creates standard ad sizes
Agent exports and names files by campaign and placement
Human: checks layouts and fixes edge cases

opportunities.title: First-draft ad copy and captions ready for editing
opportunities.description: An agent drafts ad copy and social captions from a brief, brand voice notes, and past top performers. It gives writers a clear starting point instead of a blank page.

after: Agent reads brief, brand notes, and past posts
Agent drafts captions and ad variants by platform
Agent checks tone against brand guide
Human: edits, approves, and adds final ideas
Agent formats approved copy for scheduling

opportunities.title: Revision rounds tracked and client feedback collected in one place
opportunities.description: An agent gathers feedback from email, Slack, and calls into a numbered revision list. It tracks rounds and approvals so nothing gets lost between client and creative.

Account coordinator copies notes into a document
Team asks which comments are approved
after: Agent collects feedback from email, Slack, and call notes
Agent creates a numbered revision list with source links
Agent flags unclear or conflicting requests
Human: confirms priorities with client and team
Agent updates approval status and round count

opportunities.title: Small landing page edits and tracking checks handled faster

before: Get edit request from account team
Find page and make changes manually
after: Agent reads request from Asana

Agent checks forms, pixels, and links

opportunities.title: Contractor invoices and tool renewals tracked automatically

after: Agent reads invoice and renewal emails

roadmap.title: Prove three agents on daily client work
items: Set up social scheduling and comment triage with two client accounts
Connect Meta, Google Ads, and GA4 for monthly reporting draft
Run campaign setup QA and pacing alerts for new campaigns
Keep human approval on all client-facing messages and reports
Review time saved and errors weekly

roadmap.title: Add creative and copy support
items: Pilot ad resize agent with three standard placements
Pilot copy variant agent with two copywriters
Connect revision tracking to Asana and Slack
Train team on review and approval steps

roadmap.title: Extend to web and operations, then scale
items: Add landing page edit and tracking check agent
Add invoice and renewal tracking for operations
Document each agent owner and backup
Review KPIs and expand to all clients

risks.mitigation: Human approval before send and weekly sample checks

risks.risk: Platform API limits or access changes
risks.mitigation: Start with exports and scheduled checks where APIs are limited, and keep manual fallbacks

risks.risk: Team adoption stalls because process is unclear
risks.mitigation: Name one owner per agent and train in short sessions
Limit access to need-to-know accounts, use client-specific workspaces, and review permissions quarterly
Limit phase 1 to three agents and existing tools

kpis: Hours saved per week across phase 1 agents
Average first response time to client comments and messages
Monthly reports delivered by target date
Campaign setup errors caught before launch
Revision rounds completed within agreed turnaround
Team adoption rate for each agent
